fields.name: Panel
fields.evidence: UIPrioritySystem::ProcessPanelRequests (EoCClient.dll+0xD47FF0) passes value+0 as the FixedString panel name to SendMuffleEvent and copies it with FixedString::operator= when compacting the map.

fields.name: OpenCount
fields.evidence: ProcessPanelRequests tests *(int*)(value+4) < 1 / == 0 to decide whether to post the muffle on/off event (number of open panels of that player); copied as 4 bytes on compaction.

fields.name: Players
fields.evidence: ProcessPanelRequests looks up the singleton (+0) with short keys (hash of *psVar14 % bucket count +8; keys at +0x20 stride 2, values at +0x30 stride 8) and removes entries for removed players (key from ProcessPlayerEvents, which reads short player ids from player_management::EventsSingletonComponent). Game key type is short (declared uint16_t). Live: 5 buckets, 1 entry.

fields.name: IsMuffled
fields.evidence: ProcessPanelRequests sets byte +0x40 to 1 after SendMuffleEvent(..., true, ...) and to 0 after SendMuffleEvent(..., false, ...); checked before muffling. macOS default: str xzr, [x23, #0x40]. Live: 0.
